content.text: {"name": "hours_x_separation_regime_spread", "hypothesis": "Groups with rising average hours V01 while the flow rate V02 is low relative to its own expanding history earn higher next-month returns; the interaction of hours momentum and negative V02 standardized level should rank-correlate positively with future returns.", "falsified_if": "Mean cross-sectional rank IC is nonpositive, or HAC t-statistic is below 1.5, or the top-minus-bottom tercile spread is not positive.", "expression": "mult(tsz(chg(V01,3),\"exp\"), csrank(ratio(1,tsz(V02,\"exp\"))))"}
